claim_boundary.question: Do the frozen external-information tracks independently predict the eventual BTC 5-minute Up/Down outcome on untouched historical evidence?
does_not_establish: incremental or residual value beyond the Polymarket midpoint

untouched_authority.non_overlap_rule: half-open intervals must have empty intersection with every exposed BTC experiment interval

admit_only_if: official Gamma slug and condition identity agree
official event start equals slug epoch
official market end equals start plus 300 seconds
market is closed and exactly one of Up/Down has final price 1 while the other has final price 0
raw official response and normalized row are content-addressed
exclusions: missing required external observations for a particular track

binance.event_time_rule: only exchange event timestamps at or before cutoff; archive and acquisition times are provenance, never event time

coinbase.causal_rule: use only a candle whose complete 60-second bucket ended at or before cutoff

target.role: identity and final outcome only; no historical midpoint or book substitution

tracks.definition: log return between the latest causal BTCUSDT spot aggregate-trade prices at or before T-1s and T
log return between the latest causal BTCUSDT spot aggregate-trade prices at or before T-5s and T
log return between the latest causal BTCUSDT spot aggregate-trade prices at or before T-15s and T
log return between the latest causal BTCUSDT spot aggregate-trade prices at or before T-30s and T
log return between the latest causal BTCUSDT spot aggregate-trade prices at or before T-60s and T
log return between the latest causal BTCUSDT USD-M aggregate-trade prices at or before T-1s and T
log return between the latest causal BTCUSDT USD-M aggregate-trade prices at or before T-5s and T
log return between the latest causal BTCUSDT USD-M aggregate-trade prices at or before T-15s and T
log return between the latest causal BTCUSDT USD-M aggregate-trade prices at or before T-30s and T
log return between the latest causal BTCUSDT USD-M aggregate-trade prices at or before T-60s and T
square root of the sum of squared one-second previous-tick log returns over (T-60s,T] for spot and perpetual
log of the latest causal perpetual aggregate-trade price divided by the latest causal spot aggregate-trade price at T
spot aggressive-buy notional minus aggressive-sell notional divided by total spot aggressive notional over (T-60s,T] using the official buyer-is-maker flag
perpetual aggressive-buy notional minus aggressive-sell notional divided by total perpetual aggressive notional over (T-60s,T] using the official buyer-is-maker flag
Binance spot 60-second log return minus Coinbase BTC-USD log return for the same latest fully completed UTC-minute bucket at T
Coinbase BTC-USD log return for the penultimate fully completed UTC-minute bucket minus the Binance spot log return for the immediately following fully completed bucket

feature_causality.missing_policy: track-market exclusion without interpolation, forward look, or cross-track substitution

model.family: one separate univariate logistic model per frozen track
model.baseline: development-set Up frequency as a fixed intercept-only probability
model.standardization: development mean and sample standard deviation only
model.fit: deterministic maximum penalized likelihood; intercept unpenalized; fixed L2 coefficient 0.000001

statistics.within_cluster_reduction: mean market-level paired log-loss improvement over the fixed baseline
statistics.primary_test: two-sided one-sample t test of UTC-hour paired improvements with positive direction required

strong_pass_gates: evaluation Brier score strictly below baseline Brier score

terminal_rules.PASS: at least one frozen track satisfies every strong-pass gate on evaluation
terminal_rules.FAIL: all 16 tracks have at least 125 eligible evaluation clusters and none satisfies every strong-pass gate
terminal_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: authority, causality, or power is insufficient for any frozen track; no PASS or FAIL may be claimed
terminal_rules.pass_scope: may authorize only an isolated experimental Ultra development track; residual-midpoint validation and all promotion gates remain required
terminal_rules.fail_scope: close or deprioritize the historical external-information lane
